selection_disclosure.reason_for_followup: D1 Donchian lookback 55 / hold 4 was the only conventional gold near-miss with positive development economics on both long and short sides, positive 1%-trimmed expectancy, positive expectancy after removing the best development year, and a positive 5th percentile in 100000 dependence-cluster bootstrap epochs.
original_gate_failures: 63-day sparse-event state folds were not scorable often enough
positive 63-day PnL fold fraction was below the original 60% requirement

candidate.signal: long when completed close exceeds the maximum high of the prior 55 completed D1 bars; short when completed close is below the minimum low of the prior 55 completed D1 bars
candidate.exit: open after four completed holding bars, matching the frozen development implementation

state_before_pnl.score: signed Donchian channel extension in ATR14 units on each eligible breakout event
state_before_pnl.target: signed next-open-to-frozen-exit gross return before costs

after_holdout.if_fail: retire candidate; do not test leverage or 2026 replication
after_holdout.if_pass: freeze exact candidate again before opening the 2026 historical replication; leverage remains a risk diagnostic and cannot create an edge
